gloss: little by little; gradually; bit by bit

definitions.gloss: little by little; gradually; bit by bit
definitions.explanation: Expresses gradual, incremental change or progress in small amounts at a time. Very common in everyday conversation for describing slow but steady improvement or change.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しずつ{上達|じょうたつ}している。
{天気|てんき}が{少|すこ}しずつ{良|よ}くなってきた。
examples.english: The weather has been gradually getting better.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{少|すこ}しずつ{練習|れんしゅう}すれば、{必|かなら}ず{上手|じょうず}になる。
examples.english: If you practice a little bit every day, you will definitely get better.

notes:
Expresses gradual, incremental change or action. Formed from {少|すこ}し (a little) + ずつ (each/at a time). Very commonly used in everyday conversation and writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少|すこ}しずつ{変|か}わる: to change little by little
- {少|すこ}しずつ{進|すす}む: to advance gradually
- {少|すこ}しずつ{慣|な}れる: to get used to something gradually
- {少|すこ}しずつ{良|よ}くなる: to get better little by little

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: gradually — more formal and literary; often used in written Japanese
- だんだん: gradually — emphasizes a noticeable progressive change over time
- {次第|しだい}に: gradually — literary; implies steady, inevitable progression
